steps.title: Enter Maxwell/MRC Diagnostics mode
steps.body:
Run Auto Test first: CANCEL → CANCEL → START → scroll to Auto Test → follow prompts.
Service modes: same entry (CANCEL×2+START). TEST ON shows cavity temp and door position (UO=closed, UI=open). Electric: DLB engages on entry (normal). Press CANCEL to exit.
